description: A PostHog no-code web experiment: page changes (DOM transforms) per variant, served by posthog-js through an automatically created feature flag.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the web experiment belongs to.

Id.description: The PostHog web experiment ID (an experiment ID).

Variants.description: Variants as a JSON object keyed by variant key (use Fn::ToJsonString). Each variant has `transforms` (a list of {selector, text, html, css} changes), optional `conditions` and a `rollout_percentage`, e.g. {"control": {"transforms": [], "rollout_percentage": 50}, "test": {"transforms": [{"selector": "#hero h1", "text": "Here comes Superman!"}], "rollout_percentage": 50}}.

FeatureFlagKey.description: Key of the feature flag PostHog created for the web experiment.
